capabilities: open files, headings, blocks, workspaces, and settings via URIs
create, append, prepend, and overwrite note content
run search-and-replace including RegEx in a file
read, write, and focus frontmatter properties
extras: Detailed parameter documentation lives in external docs linked from the README; the author accepts Ko-fi donations.
problem: Automating Obsidian actions normally needs mouse clicks or keyboard input; there is no built-in way to trigger deep actions like appending to daily notes or running commands from links or scripts.
summary: URI-based automation plugin that opens, edits, searches, and controls Obsidian features via obsidian://adv-uri links from browsers, scripts, or notes.
